definitions.explanation: Japan's main conservative political party, abbreviated from {自由民主党|じゆうみんしゅとう}. It has governed Japan for most of the postwar era.

examples.japanese: {自民党|じみんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自民党|じみんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧だ。
examples.english: He is an LDP Diet member.

examples.japanese: {自民党|じみんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}って→握る：02383_nigiru⟧きた。
examples.english: The LDP has held power for a long time.

notes:
Abbreviation of {自由民主党|じゆうみんしゅとう} (Liberal Democratic Party), Japan's largest conservative political party. Founded in 1955, it has been the dominant party in government for most of the postwar period.

- ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧: the ruling party — which the {自民党|じみんとう} has usually been
